license: MIT, as stated in the upstream LICENSE file retained verbatim here. Upstream package.json says ISC; its conflicting metadata was not copied.
scope: Seven core lib JavaScript files. Upstream web application, localtime helper, and tests are not runtime dependencies.
patches: Accept an explicit lunar-javascript Solar calendar object; the adapter supplies fixed UTC+08:00 civil components instead of host-local Date.
Use getPrevJieQi(false) for the actual solar-term instant rather than treating the entire calendar day as the new term.
Use exact LiChun year/month and 23:00 day pillars; align day yuan and day xun with the same day boundary.
Count ZhiShi from the original xun-head palace, including center five; only lodge a resulting center palace into Kun two after counting.
rule: 时家转盘·符头拆补 / 23:00 换日 / 北京时间 UTC+08:00 / 中五寄坤二、天禽随芮
ruleNaming: Upstream README calls its method 茅山 and a test comment calls it 置闰. This adapter names the actual fu-tou / term-table implementation, not those conflicting labels.
knownLimits: No true solar time; no flying-plate, zhiyin leap insertion, or alternative school comparison. Upstream maturity and passing invariants alone are not independent correctness proof.
validationNote: Audit report and engine hash files are unchanged between published main 29f9c9e and the local sync source 16ccd70.
